lessons_used: Waiting screen enhancements (wait_info) can be helpful, producing significant gains in two tests (+5.0% and +5.7%), though two tests showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) can be helpful, winning two tests (+15.4% and +6.4%), though one test significantly hurt performance (-7.7%).
Copy adjustments (copy), layout changes (layout), sign-in reordering (reorder), redesigns (redesign), and hints (hint) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins, such as the pet preview screen (+3.0% predicted vs +15.4% measured) and sound selection screen (+4.0% predicted vs +6.4% measured).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that showed no clear effect or resulted in a loss (e.g., predicting +15.4% for the quiz screen which measured -7.7%).

candidates.title: Companion Behavior Audio Teaser Screen
candidates.change: Adds an interactive audio preview screen right before adoption certificate where users can sample reaction sounds.
candidates.why: Adding new screens during adoption setup has yielded strong historical conversion gains (+6.4% and +15.4%).

new_pet_sounds.headline: Listen to Your Pet's Reactions
new_pet_sounds.body: Hear how your companion responds when happy, curious, or playful.

guard.reason: Adds a valid pet sound preview screen into onboarding without skipping steps or breaking rules.

candidates.score_note: Adding targeted new screens during adoption has historical gains, though cost is high.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Walkthrough
candidates.change: Redesigns home_intro into a split view spotlighting desktop shortcut keys, pet movement controls, and chat commands.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent complaints from users who are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

home_intro.headline: Master Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Learn the essential shortcuts and clicks to summon, interact with, and manage your pet anytime.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Account Recovery and Sync Security Banner
candidates.change: Adds an explicit data sync and recovery hint on the sign in screen clarifying how existing pets stay saved.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in securely links your companion to your account so your pet progress is saved upon re-logging.

guard.reason: Adds an informative account sync hint to the sign-in screen without changing core behavior.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email evidence for sign-in sync issues, low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Care Quiz Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a companion preference quiz screen before path selection to help users select their ideal interaction style.
candidates.why: Adding targeted new screens in early onboarding steps has historically boosted funnel progression.

new_style_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Companion Vibe
new_style_quiz.body: Select how active or quiet you want your desktop pet to be while you work.

guard.reason: Inserts a companion style quiz screen inside onboarding without removing any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Historical quiz screens significantly hurt onboarding flow in past tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Habit & Routine Scheduler Screen
candidates.change: Adds a daily pet activity scheduling screen while waiting for the background engine to complete setup.
candidates.why: Enhancing the waiting period with active setup screens increases retention and reduces perceived wait duration.

new_pet_routine.headline: Set Your Companion's Daily Schedule
new_pet_routine.body: Choose when your desktop companion plays, rests, or keeps you company during work hours.

guard.reason: Adds a routine scheduling screen into onboarding after waiting without omitting any steps.

candidates.score_note: Home step has lower drop-off; complex new screen requires full release.

components.text: Ensure bright front lighting with centered face framing

guard.reason: Updates the photo upload screen layout to a checklist format while preserving its core function.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 3 tickets, but layout changes historically show little effect.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Troubleshooting Checklist
candidates.change: Adds a display permission hint component to the waiting screen explaining desktop overlay permissions.

components.text: If your pet doesn't appear on screen immediately, verify desktop overlay permissions in your OS settings.

guard.reason: Adds permission hint text to the waiting screen, which is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Wait_info changes have strong historical performance and match support tickets.

guard.reason: The redesigned adoption certificate replaces the required official stamp with a badge, losing the official stamp required by Rule 2.
